payload.title: File:Gecko and Milkyway.jpg
payload.description_html: A nocturnal gecko endemic to northern Chile was captured while observing the Milky Way in the Rio Hurtado area. It was incredible to find this reptile hunting insects next to my flashlight that remained on the ground, then our little friend climbed onto a rock and stayed there for a couple of minutes during which I quickly took advantage of the opportunity to photograph it.This is a single-exposure photograph with no digital manipulation, just development and basic corrections. The Gecko was undisturbed and untouched.
